method: Verified source hashes and unchecked-key coverage against the shard manifest; reviewed each task's active section and preparation/acceptance boundary, with source-level corrections for PAW-3 and agent-harness contracts. No JEV refinement proposed: these candidate tasks are host authorization, evaluation-contract design, or benchmark truth/held-out performance; typed decisions cannot grant tool permission or supply those outcome labels. PAW-3 manifest/Vidya-adapter preparation is separated from later FuzzyBench evaluation, and AC-CHECKPOINT-ALLOC fixture replay is separated from held-out screening. Source review was bounded to the listed handoff sections and named APP typed-decision contracts; no inference, build, service, or execution performed.
